clips.title: The story
paras: Devouring Plague is a rite of instruction offered to Forsaken priests who have proven their dedication to shadow magic. Granted by Priestess Aelthalyste in the Undercity, the teaching marks an acolyte's initiation into one of the most dreaded curses woven by the undead priesthood.

In the murky cloisters of the War Quarter, Priestess Aelthalyste guides Forsaken practitioners through the grim arts of the Shadow. While living priests of other races appeal to the Holy Light or ancestral spirits for their power, the Forsaken have forged their own spiritual doctrines. Devouring Plague represents the crystallization of their philosophy: inflicting suffering upon their foes while leeching the stolen vitality back into their own decaying bodies.

Aelthalyste does not offer the knowledge of the plague lightly. The spell is considered a weapon of potent malice, intended to turn the tide against the Scourge and the Scarlet Crusade. When imparting the spell, Aelthalyste warns her disciples to hone their command over it through relentless practice, cautioning that far greater trials lie ahead for those who seek to master the dark arts.

clips.title: Completion
paras: I would teach you Devouring Plague if you feel you are prepared, friend. A spell of no small power, it will aid you in your coming battles. Practice with it--there will be tests later.
